title: Canonical unit comparison for module inverse image
statement: Let f:Z to X be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and A a commutative ring sheaf on the pro-etale site. Use the actual ring and module inverse images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and the module category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write P and Q for the source and target forgetful functors to abelian sheaves. For every adjunction ai between the specified module inverse image and pushforward through the ring unit, and every source module M, the abelian adjunct of P(ai.unit at M) is an isomorphism from the abelian inverse image of P(M) to Q(f_module_inverse_image(M)). There is no closed immersion hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3, Modules on Sites, Lemmas 18.12.2 and 18.12.3: scalar action on inverse image and restriction of the abelian Hom equivalence. The canonical-unit refinement of the existing module underlying comparison.

proof.text: Choose the canonical adjunction and its invertible underlying unit mate from the canonical-unit intermediate theorem.

For an arbitrary supplied adjunction, uniqueness of left adjoints gives a natural isomorphism of inverse-image functors. The adjunction unit identity expresses the arbitrary mate as the composite of the canonical mate and the image of this uniqueness isomorphism; the latter is invertible, so the composite is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Canonical-unit split followed by adjunction uniqueness and hom-equivalence naturality.

theorem proEtaleModuleInverseImage_unitComparison_isIso {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (A : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (ai : proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A ⊣
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := proEtaleBaseChange i)
      (J := ProEt.topology X) (K := ProEt.topology Z)
      (S := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A)) (R := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app A).hom
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})⟩)) :
    let S := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj A
    let R := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Z)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj A)
    ∀ M, IsIso (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).obj M)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage i A).obj M))).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).map (ai.unit.app M)))
